entities.name: Zosimos
entities.description: A young human who walks toward Meletis worried about winning glory and the gods' favor, and is awakened as a hero by a satyr's teaching.

entities.name: The Satyr
entities.description: A stout, playful, unnamed satyr who teaches Zosimos that worry is Phenax's creation and that a hero leaves behind goodness, and who gives him a rusty knife.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god who, the satyr says, created worry; worrying is worshipping him.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A god heroes seek to please; the satyr says worshipping Phenax spurns him.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god whose favor heroes seek.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A god whose favor heroes seek.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the Underworld, who the satyr says covets the living world and seals the dead within it.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god whose virulent poison the satyr compares to worry.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead where coinsmiths mint clay ostraka from funerary masks.

entities.name: Coinsmiths of the Underworld
entities.description: Craftsmen of the Underworld who mint clay coins called ostraka from funerary masks of the dead.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: Soulless, moaning dead who return from the Underworld by forging a new identity.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The city Zosimos was traveling to before turning toward the eastern mountains.

events.summary: Zosimos, walking by the woods, is overtaken by worry that he will never gain the glory and favor of the gods like other heroes.
events.quote: What if he died having never gained the favor of the gods?

events.summary: A satyr springs onto the path, tells Zosimos his mind's garden is full of weeds, and says worry is Phenax's creation that spurns Iroas.
events.quote: When you worry, you're actually worshipping Phenax.

events.summary: The satyr tells of the Underworld's coinsmiths who mint ostraka from funerary masks, and explains that Erebos equalizes everyone and forbids a return except as one of the Returned.
events.quote: Erebos cares little for what you were in life. He only cares that you once existed.

events.summary: The satyr teaches that a true hero is concerned with what he leaves behind, the flowering of goodness, rather than titles or a death mask.
events.quote: A hero is not concerned with a death mask or a fancy title or property, a hero is concerned with the flowering of goodness in all its forms.

events.summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a taste of nectarvine sap and tells him the world is good, and that a hero brings awareness of it and defends people from harm.
events.quote: The world is good, my boy.

events.summary: The satyr gives Zosimos a dull, rusty knife and warns that darkness will try to snuff out an awakened hero's light, then skips off into the woods.
events.quote: When a hero is awakened, all manner of things come from the darkness to snuff out the hero's light.

events.summary: Transformed, Zosimos leaves the path to Meletis and follows a pull toward the eastern mountains, abandoning thoughts he calls the seeds of Phenax.
The satyr's dagger bursts into heat and light, becoming a shining sword forged by the gods.
events.quote: the satyr's dagger had become a shining sword forged by the gods.

relations.note: The satyr gives Zosimos lessons on heroism.
relations.quote: It looks like you need some lessons.

relations.note: Erebos seals the dead within the Underworld.
relations.quote: He seals us within the Underworld, from which there is no return

relations.note: The coinsmiths mint coins for use in the Underworld.
relations.quote: They mint coins for use in the Underworld.
